name: decouple_slice
description: Decouple one feature boundary inside the app: its work moves behind JSON backend controllers, and the page-side controllers reach them over loopback HTTP and render the same JSP; behaviour parity.

name: oneshot_decoupling
description: Decouple the whole sample in one run (every case): every page-side controller reaches the backend over loopback HTTP and holds no service or data access; JSP stays.

name: dummy_file
description: Smoke test: write one file and stop. Proves an agent acts on the checkout at all, without any app work.

name: agent_probe
description:
Probe: read the files it names, derive the values they hold, write one
file, stop. Tests whether an agent converts research into an edit instead
of reading indefinitely.
